---
title: "Interdigital capacitor"
sidebar: get-started
---

`interdigital_capacitor` creates a pair of interleaved electrodes with CPW
terminal extensions. Its public ports sit at the outer CPW cut planes.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("interdigital_capacitor")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fingers` | 20 | Number of interleaved fingers. |
| `finger_length` | 100 µm | Finger length. |
| `finger_gap`, `finger_width` | 3.3 µm, 3.3 µm | Nominal finger spacing and width. |
| `taper_length` | 150 µm | Terminal taper length. |
| `terminal_extension_length_um` | 100 µm | Length of each CPW terminal extension. |
| `capacitor_ground_gap` | 85 µm | Gap to the ground-mask contour. |
| `cpw_xs` | `coplanar_waveguide` | CPW cross-section. |
| `half` | `False` | Selects the full or half geometry. |
| `corner_radius_um` | 0 µm | Fillet radius; zero keeps sharp corners. |

## Ports and layers

`o_capacitor_in` and `o_capacitor_out` are at the outer CPW cut planes.
Standalone terminals remain open; assembled CPW routes connect at these planes.
The factory creates DRAW, GROUND_MASK, and derived ETCH geometry.

## Corner radius

The default `corner_radius_um=0` keeps sharp contours. A positive radius rounds
the merged electrode and ground-mask contours while preserving flat outer cut
planes, ports, and nominal straight finger/end gaps. Tangent arcs that cannot
fit raise `ValueError`; the requested radius is not reduced. Corner-local
clearances can therefore differ from the nominal straight gaps. This geometry
setting does not certify fabrication, design-rule compliance, or solver results.
The radius must be finite and nonnegative. Outer and hole contours are rounded
independently; arcs are sampled at no more than 5° per chord, then quantized to
the existing PDK grid.
